title: TekTopia Classic Faithful 32x Add-on
description: A Classic Faithful resource pack add-on for TangoTek's TekTopia mod.
body: If you believe that any updates need to be made, please let me know in the comments! As far as I can tell, TekTopia is still on version 1.1.0, and the available textures still match with that update. This requires the original [Faithful resource pack](https://faithfulpack.net/classicfaithful/32x-programmer-art), TangoTek's [TekTopia mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tektopia), and my [Tektopia Classic Faithful 32x pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tektopia-classic-faithful-32x)! Go download them if you haven't already! This pack needs to be placed above my other addon pack to work correctly. In order from bottom to top, it should be the default pack, the faithful pack, my original faithful tektopia pack, and then this addon. Credit for the idea and some of the textures go to Vattic. Credit for the original assets goes to TangoTek.
